mapper.sql: concat_ws(', ', 'show=' || (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_show_time x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0), 'reRelease=' || (SELECT count(*) FROM re_release x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0), 'benefit=' || (SELECT count(*) FROM benefit x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0), 'presale=' || (SELECT count(*) FROM presale x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0), 'comment=' || (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_comment x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0), 'rate=' || (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_rate x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id), 'staff=' || (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_staff x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0), 'character=' || (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_character x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0), 'spec=' || (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_spec x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0), 'tag=' || (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_tag_tags x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0), 'version=' || (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_version x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0) )

WITH flagged AS ( SELECT mv.id, mv.tmdb_id, mv.name, mv.deleted, (mv.deleted = 1 AND ( mv.movie_key LIKE '%:merged-%' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM movie_merge_log ml WHERE ml.loser_movie_id = mv.id) )) AS merged_away FROM movie mv WHERE mv.kind = 'movie' ) SELECT 'same_tmdb' AS group_type, tmdb_id::text AS group_value FROM flagged WHERE tmdb_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tmdb_id HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE deleted = 0) >= 1 AND count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT merged_away) >= 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'same_name' AS group_type, lower(btrim(name)) AS group_value FROM flagged WHERE btrim(coalesce(name, '')) <> '' GROUP BY lower(btrim(name)) HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE deleted = 0) >= 1 AND count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT merged_away) >= 2
mapper.select: SELECT g.group_type, g.group_value FROM ( ) g ORDER BY g.group_type, g.group_value LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.id, m.name, m.movie_key, m.tmdb_id, m.deleted, m.kind, to_char(m.release_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS release_date, (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_show_time st WHERE st.movie_id = m.id AND st.deleted = 0) AS show_count, AS reference_summary FROM movie m WHERE m.kind = 'movie' AND ( (#{groupType} = 'same_tmdb' AND m.tmdb_id::text = #{groupValue}) OR (#{groupType} = 'same_name' AND lower(btrim(m.name)) = #{groupValue}) ) ORDER BY (m.tmdb_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, m.deleted ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT m.id, m.name, m.movie_key, m.tmdb_id, m.deleted, m.kind, to_char(m.release_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS release_date, (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_show_time st WHERE st.movie_id = m.id AND st.deleted = 0) AS show_count, AS reference_summary FROM movie m WHERE m.id = #{id}

SELECT m.id, m.name, m.original_name, m.movie_key, m.tmdb_id, m.deleted, m.kind, to_char(m.release_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS release_date, m.time AS runtime, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.cover_url, ''), m.cover) AS cover, m.description, m.level_id AS level_id, lv.name AS level_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_show_time x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0) AS c_show, (SELECT count(*) FROM re_release x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0) AS c_rerelease, (SELECT count(*) FROM benefit x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0) AS c_benefit, (SELECT count(*) FROM presale x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0) AS c_presale, (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_comment x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0) AS c_comment, (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_rate x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id) AS c_rate, (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_staff x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0) AS c_staff, (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_character x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0) AS c_character, (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_spec x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0) AS c_spec, (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_tag_tags x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0) AS c_tag, (SELECT count(*) FROM movie_version x WHERE x.movie_id = m.id AND x.deleted = 0) AS c_version FROM movie m LEFT JOIN level lv ON m.level_id = lv.id WHERE m.id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT mv.version_code AS version_code, l.name AS language FROM movie_version mv LEFT JOIN language l ON mv.language_id = l.id WHERE mv.movie_id = #{id} AND mv.deleted = 0 ORDER BY mv.version_code LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT movie_tag.name FROM movie_tag_tags LEFT JOIN movie_tag ON movie_tag_tags.movie_tag_id = movie_tag.id WHERE movie_tag_tags.deleted = 0 AND movie_tag_tags.movie_id = #{id} AND movie_tag.name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY movie_tag.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT cinema_spec.name FROM movie_spec LEFT JOIN cinema_spec ON movie_spec.spec_id = cinema_spec.id WHERE movie_spec.deleted = 0 AND movie_spec.movie_id = #{id} AND cinema_spec.name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cinema_spec.name LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT st.cinema_id AS cinema_id, c.name AS cinema_name, count(*) AS count, min(left(st.start_time, 10)) AS first_date, max(left(st.start_time, 10)) AS last_date FROM movie_show_time st LEFT JOIN cinema c ON st.cinema_id = c.id WHERE st.movie_id = #{id} AND st.deleted = 0 GROUP BY st.cinema_id, c.name ORDER BY count(*) DESC, st.cinema_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT staff.name AS name, "position".name AS position FROM movie_staff LEFT JOIN staff ON movie_staff.staff_id = staff.id LEFT JOIN "position" ON movie_staff.position_id = "position".id WHERE movie_staff.deleted = 0 AND movie_staff.movie_id = #{id} ORDER BY movie_staff.position_id, movie_staff.staff_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT character.name FROM movie_character LEFT JOIN character ON movie_character.character_id = character.id WHERE movie_character.deleted = 0 AND movie_character.movie_id = #{id} AND character.name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY movie_character.character_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT count(*) FROM pending_movie_match p JOIN movie candidate ON candidate.id = p.candidate_movie_id JOIN movie matched ON matched.id = p.matched_movie_id WHERE p.status = 'PENDING' AND NOT ( candidate.deleted = 1 AND ( candidate.movie_key LIKE '%:merged-%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM movie_merge_log ml WHERE ml.loser_movie_id = candidate.id ) ) ) AND NOT ( matched.deleted = 1 AND ( matched.movie_key LIKE '%:merged-%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM movie_merge_log ml WHERE ml.loser_movie_id = matched.id ) ) )

SELECT p.id, p.candidate_movie_id, p.matched_movie_id, p.candidate_title, p.matched_title, p.confidence, p.match_reason, p.status, to_char(p.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS create_time, to_char(p.update_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS update_time FROM pending_movie_match p JOIN movie candidate ON candidate.id = p.candidate_movie_id JOIN movie matched ON matched.id = p.matched_movie_id WHERE p.status = 'PENDING' AND NOT ( candidate.deleted = 1 AND ( candidate.movie_key LIKE '%:merged-%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM movie_merge_log ml WHERE ml.loser_movie_id = candidate.id ) ) ) AND NOT ( matched.deleted = 1 AND ( matched.movie_key LIKE '%:merged-%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM movie_merge_log ml WHERE ml.loser_movie_id = matched.id ) ) ) ORDER BY p.confidence DESC, p.update_time DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE presale SET deleted = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE movie_id = #{loserId} AND deleted = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM presale s WHERE s.movie_id = #{survivorId} AND s.deleted = 0 )

UPDATE re_release l SET deleted = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE l.movie_id = #{loserId} AND l.deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(l.display_name_override, '') <> '' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM re_release s WHERE s.movie_id = #{survivorId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(s.display_name_override, '') = COALESCE(l.display_name_override, '') )

UPDATE movie_show_time SET deleted = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM ( SELECT id, row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY cinema_id, theater_hall_id, start_time ORDER BY (can_sale IS TRUE) DESC, (open IS TRUE) DESC, update_time DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC ) AS rn FROM movie_show_time WHERE movie_id = #{survivorId} AND deleted = 0 ) ranked WHERE ranked.rn > 1 )
UPDATE movie SET deleted = 0, name = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(#{newName}), ''), name), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE movie
original_name = #{o.originalName},
release_date = to_date(#{o.releaseDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
"time" = #{o.runtime}, cover_url = #{o.cover}, description = #{o.description}, tmdb_id = #{o.tmdbId}, level_id = #{o.levelId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = #{survivorId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO movie_merge_log (survivor_movie_id, loser_movie_id, survivor_movie_key, loser_movie_key, survivor_tmdb_id, loser_tmdb_id, survivor_name, loser_name, operator_user_id, note, create_time) VALUES (#{survivor.id}, #{loser.id}, #{survivor.movieKey}, #{loser.movieKey}, #{survivor.tmdbId}, #{loser.tmdbId}, #{survivor.name}, #{loser.name}, #{operatorUserId}, #{note}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO movie_merge_alias (alias_title, survivor_movie_id, survivor_movie_key, survivor_tmdb_id, source, deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{aliasTitle}, #{survivor.id}, #{survivor.movieKey}, #{survivor.tmdbId}, 'admin_merge', 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (lower(btrim(alias_title))) WHERE deleted = 0 DO UPDATE SET survivor_movie_id = EXCLUDED.survivor_movie_id, survivor_movie_key = EXCLUDED.survivor_movie_key, survivor_tmdb_id = EXCLUDED.survivor_tmdb_id, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE pending_movie_match SET status = #{status}, decided_by = #{operatorUserId}, decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
